name: Ohel
title: Descendant of King David
summary: Ohel was a descendant of King David through the lineage of Zerubbabel. He is mentioned in the genealogy of David in 1 Chronicles. Although little is known about his life, he is part of the royal Davidic line that was preserved through the exile.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Ohel is listed as one of the sons of Shemaiah in the genealogy of David's descendants after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Davidic line after the exile
keyEvents.description: Ohel belonged to the royal lineage from David through Zerubbabel, which was preserved during the Babylonian exile.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Zerubbabel
keyEvents.description: As part of Zerubbabel's descendants, Ohel was part of a lineage that carried the promise of a future messianic king from the house of David.

keyEvents.title: Continuation of the Lineage
keyEvents.description: Ohel's place in the genealogy shows that David's royal line continued to be carefully recorded even after Babylon's destruction of Jerusalem and the exile.
